ai_summary: Sandeep Gupta and Persons Acting in Concert, members of the promoter group of Asian Hotels (West) Limited, have increased their collective shareholding by 1.72% to 21.46% through an inter-se transfer. This internal transaction consolidates the promoter group's control without impacting the company's total equity share capital or diluting other shareholders. A significant red flag is the specified acquisition date of 30.09.2026, indicating a future transaction for a current regulatory disclosure, which requires further clarification.
